rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; data from the Utrecht Schizophrenia Project and the GROUP (Genetic Risk and Outcome of Psychosis) consortium, which is explicitly described as a multi-site longitudinal cohort study; 2 scanners (I/II) used
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Genetic Risk and Outcome of Psychosis (GROUP), a multi-site longitudinal cohort study focused on gene-environment interaction"
rci1_using_msad.location: Janssen2021.pdf.md: Methods / Sample and Neuroimaging; References #30 (Korver et al., 2012)

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference cohort drawn from the Utrecht Schizophrenia Project and the GROUP consortium; neither is an established public dataset (EPD) per the confirmed EPD list
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Detailed information regarding diagnostic criteria and clinical assessments of the Utrecht Schizophrenia project and the Genetic Risk and Outcome of Psychosis consortium are described in 29-31"

rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Detailed information regarding diagnostic criteria and clinical assessments of the Utrecht Schizophrenia project and the Genetic Risk and Outcome of Psychosis consortium are described in 29-31"

rci5_n.detail: All 164 healthy controls used as the normative reference; no explicit train/test split; normative reference calculated at each time point (baseline and follow-up) from the same HC sample
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The final data set consisted of 656 scans from 164 healthy participants and 164 patients."
rci5_n.location: Janssen2021.pdf.md: Methods / Sample and Neuroimaging; Table 1

rci6_sex.detail: Male n (126) and percentage (77%) reported directly in Table 1 for healthy controls; female_n estimated from total N (164) minus male_n (126) = 38; female_pct calculated as 38/164 = 23.2%

rci7_age.detail: Baseline age statistics for healthy controls from Table 1 (mean 31.04, SD 11.65); age range (16-70 years at baseline) from Methods section; age in years
rci7_age.supporting_text: "Age, y: mean (SD) | 31.04 (11.65) [Healthy controls, Baseline]"; Methods: "a large longitudinal sample of patients with schizophrenia and healthy participants aged 16-70 years (at baseline)"
rci7_age.location: Janssen2021.pdf.md: Methods / Sample and Neuroimaging; Table 1
